# montecarlo_tableau_credentials (Resource)

Tableau credentials are a password, a personal access token or a connected app Monte Carlo stores for Tableau connections to use. The secret is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_name` (String) URL of the Tableau server, starting with https:// or http://.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `connected_app_client_id` (String) Client ID of a Tableau connected app. Send it with `connected_app_secret_id`, `connected_app_secret_value` and `username`.
- `connected_app_secret_id` (String) ID of the connected app's secret. An identifier, not the secret itself.
- `connected_app_secret_value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Value of the connected app's secret in `connected_app_secret_id`. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `connected_app_secret_value_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `connected_app_secret_value_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of `username`. Send this, a personal access token, or a connected app. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `site_name` (String) Tableau site to connect to. Leave it out for the default site.
- `token_name` (String) Name of a personal access token. Send it with `token_value`.
- `token_value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret of the personal access token in `token_name`. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `token_value_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `token_value_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `username` (String) Tableau user. Send it with `password`, or with a connected app. Not used with a personal access token.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate. Verified when left out.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
